properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's North-blocks pass: real OSM building footprint. Arterra, 300 Berry St -- ~275-unit condo tower, developer Intracorp SF, architect Kwan Henmi, built 2009. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: (1) The cited SocketSite post (2006-04-26) gives 268 units, not ~275; nothing cited gives 275, so read the unit count as 268 per that post. (2) The 2009 built year is supported by the DataSF Assessor roll: the per-unit condominium lots at 300 Berry St (e.g. parcel 8704012) carry year_property_built 2009; the 2006 post itself gives no completion year and OSM has no start_date. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same pattern already used for Mission Bay's other condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon I, Madrone and Radiance, re-checked against data/raw/parcels.geojson in the 2026-09 audit; Avalon II and III are not condo-mapped, and Arden and One Mission Bay were not re-checked).'. REPLACED 2026-10-12 (shape; status and use unchanged): the owner approved building records whose outline matches an Assessor lot at 85% or better, both ways, using the lot (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing'). DataSF's Assessor layer (data/raw/parcels.geojson) has Assessor lot 8704008 (3,887 m2, active, mapped 2008-07-29); the earlier outline of 3,818 m2 and the lot overlap with IoU 0.95 (98% of the earlier outline lies inside the lot and it covers 97% of the lot). The outline is now that lot using the lots' own vertices (no simplification). The lot is condominium-mapped: 270 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8704008 and 269 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. geometry_type stays 'real'. Previous digitized_from: 'OpenStreetMap (way 48569995, 300 Berry St)'. Previous accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcel data), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be mapped from one parcel the way a single-owner building can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same pattern already used for Mission Bay's other condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon I, Madrone and Radiance, re-checked against DataSF's parcel data in September 2026; Avalon II and III are not condo-mapped, and Arden and One Mission Bay were not re-checked).'. 2026-10-12 accuracy audit (text only; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type): the parenthetical quoted just above, 'Avalon II and III are not condo-mapped', is wrong for Avalon II. In DataSF's Assessor layer (data/raw/parcels.geojson), Avalon II's map lot 8705011 has four lots sharing one footprint (8705011 to 8705014, all addressed 301 King St), not many per-unit lots; Avalon III (8705006) is a single lot; Avalon I (8706011) has 252 lots and Arden (8710010) 267. Madrone and Radiance were not re-checked. The current accuracy_caveat above carries none of that parenthetical.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8704008 (3,887 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 270 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8704008 and 269 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (OpenStreetMap (way 48569995, 300 Berry St)); 98% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 97% of the lot.
